messages.content: You read science figures so they can be made into tactile graphics for blind students. List the figure's parts as short noun phrases a segmentation model can find. Use the figure's own printed labels. Do not add parts that are not in the figure.

content.text: Read this figure and fill the schema.

summary.description: Two sentences at most. No sight words.

phrase.description: Short noun phrase SAM can segment, such as 'left ventricle'

print_label.description: The exact printed label text that points to this part, or empty
